Wonderful Spanish Meal
Nov 2023 • Solo
This longtime District 2 northern Spanish restaurant has a large menu, inc dishes for 2 people to share. I had two wonderful appetizers, which together made for a full dinner. 
The Iberian sausage pieces is a house specialties, and the prawns in garlic sauce were large & many, around 7-8. House red wine accompanied. I ate outside by the swimming pool. Very nice meal. Attentive staff.

A very pleasant discovery
May 2020
1st visit. we were looking for a typical Spanish food restaurant and it was a real discovery. The menu has a lot of choice in typical Spanish food and some unique specialities. Tapas we chose were very tasty and well prepared. Salmon salad has a unique flavor. Gambas with garlic sauce (big shrimps) were really tasty. Albondigas well cooked and the sauce was the best I can remember. Nice wine menu with typical Spanish. the owners are very friendly and helped us the make the choice.
